lore.bio:
When Loba was nine, she looked on as simulacrum hitman Revenant killed her family. Left with nothing, Loba survived by picking pockets, using every tool at her disposal to lift herself from the gutter - including an experimental Jump Drive, pilfered from a supposedly impenetrable research facility. She was just that good.
With her new teleportation bracelet, the most secure and unattainable items were within Loba's reach, and so was her dream of living the high life. Rumors spread across the Outlands: if you wanted something valuable -and well guarded- Loba was your woman.
She was almost able to put her past behind her. But when Revenant joined the Games, her past catapulted into her future. Desperate to find a way to kill him, she sabotaged a facility full of Revenant bodies, bringing Skull Town and Thunderdome crashing down in the process. However, she learned it was just one of many such factories hidden across the Frontier. After finding out Revenant wishes for death, she’s made it her mission to keep him alive as revenge. She plays in the Games to keep getting vengeance on Revenant, but.it doesn’t hurt that the arenas are brimming with treasures just waiting to be plucked.

For more information on Loba's story, see Loba (character).

passive.name: Eye for Quality
passive.description: Nearby epic and legendary loot, as well as unopened Care Packages, can be seen through walls with increased scan range and duration. The range is the same as Black Market Boutique. Open loot vaults without a key. Loba can ADS when unarmed to see the loot UI for items highlighted by her passive.

tactical.name: Burglar's Blitz
tactical.description: Teleport to hard-to-reach places or escape trouble quickly by throwing your jump drive bracelet, with increased movement speed and scan speed. The bracelet now works in more areas and fixes issues with getting stuck.

ultimate.name: Black Market Boutique
ultimate.description: Place a portable device that allows you to teleport nearby loot to your inventory. Ammo, small meds and teammate banners are free. The gas zone has been reduced in size. Ammo taken no longer has a maximum limit nor takes up space towards the two items allowed to be taken.

tactics.playstyle: Loba is the queen of looting. Her playstyle ensures the team always has ammo and meds, allowing them to hold positions without running out of resources. Her bracelet offers a quick escape.

left.name: Wolf's Claws
left.description: Faster weapon draw and speed boost after translocating.

right.name: Shopping Spree
right.description: Squad can take 3 items from a friendly Black Market Boutique.

left.name: Escape Artist
left.description: Loba can regenerate 25 shield HP after translocating.

right.name: Brand New Bag
right.description: Grants the entire squad gold backpacks when selected.
